Study of Railway bridges

MUKHERJEE: Will the Minister of
RAILWAYS be pleased to state:

been drawn to the new-sitem captioned,
"Railway Staff study bridges abroad",

4th November, 2002;

proposal to send a Railway team abroad,

be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Centre had decided to
release more funds from the Contingency
Fund, to help the drought and flood affected

released funds to the affected States; and

Will the Minister of CHEMICALS

issuing the license;

discoveries made by the above Institute are
pending for clearance from Central
Insecticides Board; and

clearance?

the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE

Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes;

Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes;

the Minister of ENVIRONMENT AND
